name: @senclaw/space-sdk
description: Build a SenClaw Space App in TypeScript: daemon API, AI bridge, MCP server harness, an OpenAI-compatible LLM-provider router, and the lifecycle helpers an on-demand app needs.
author: SenClaw

comments.exports: Root export ('.') is browser+node safe with no runtime deps. './mcp' is Node-only (pulls express + @modelcontextprotocol/sdk) and './lifecycle' is Node-only (reads process.env, installs signal handlers) — import either only from server processes, never from browser app code.
comments.files: `dist` is published but never committed (.gitignore). `prepare` is what rebuilds it — npm runs that both before publishing AND when this package is installed as a `file:`/git dependency, which is how the in-repo apps that depend on it get a build without anyone remembering to run `npm run build` first. `src` ships too so published types resolve their sources in an editor.
